title: Verible RTL Brain rule
description: A single YAML lint rule loadable at runtime by the Verible daemon's pattern engine. Files matching this schema live under <project>/rules/, ~/.duducode/rtl-brain/rules/user/, ~/.duducode/teams/<team>/rtl-rules/, or ~/.duducode/rtl-brain/rules/community/.

name.description: Globally unique snake_case rule id. Must equal the filename without the .yaml suffix.

version.description: Bumped whenever the rule changes meaning (not for cosmetic edits).

author.description: Free-form. Use 'ai-rtl-debug-skill' / 'ai-rtl-author-skill' for AI-authored rules so telemetry can distinguish.

source-scope.description: Scope in which this rule originated.

promoted-from.description: If this rule was promoted from a lower-precedence scope, what scope did it come from. null otherwise.

topic.description: Loose category for grouping in reports. Common values: timing, cdc, reset, naming, fsm, ram, latches, fanout, dataflow.

why-bad.description: Human-readable explanation of why a hit is a problem. Surfaced verbatim to the user and to LLM oracle decision points.

suggested-fix.description: Human-readable fix advice. The /fpga-close-timing and /rtl-debug skills feed this to the LLM when generating patch proposals.

pattern.description: CST pattern. Compiled at load time into a verible::matcher::Matcher tree.

condition.description: Semantic-level filter that runs after the CST pattern matches. Uses primitives registered in pattern-engine/semantic-primitives. A1 ignores this field; A3 evaluates it.

bad.description: Relative path (from the rule file) to a SV snippet that MUST fire this rule. Required by corpus-validator.

good.description: Relative path (from the rule file) to a SV snippet that MUST NOT fire this rule. Required by corpus-validator.

stats.description: Asynchronously written by rule-stats after each scan. Do not edit by hand.

node.description: NodeEnum tag. Accepted with or without the leading 'k', e.g. 'kBinaryExpression' or 'BinaryExpression'.

bind.description: Capture this match under the given name. Visible to condition primitives and surfaced as a binding to RPC clients.

inner.description: Direct children that must also match. Equivalent to Matcher::AddMatchers.

descend.description: Path of NodeEnum tags to walk before matching. Equivalent to MakePathMatcher.

leaf.description: Literal token text to match (e.g. '==', 'always_ff', 'posedge'). Tokens are matched by text, not by enum, in A1.

condition.description: Boolean tree over semantic primitives. Empty / missing condition means: pattern hit is the result.

any.description: At least one child must hold.

primitive.description: Registered primitive name. The full list is in pattern-engine/semantic-primitives.cc (added in A3).

target.description: Name of a bind from the pattern section.

arg.description: Optional scalar argument (e.g. the integer for bit_width_ge).
